Bill.BriefDescription: Forfeiting lead agency status for nonperformance.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to lead agency status for the construction oftransportation projects; and adding a new section to chapter 47.28 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.28 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A county designated as the lead agency for the construction of atransportation project that fails to meet specific milestones orperform the duties required of it as a lead agency within a reasonabletime from the applicable dates established in the original agreementgoverning the project shall forfeit its lead agency status and shallremit any funds previously provided to it for the project to thedepartment. Agreements between the department and a lead agency mustinclude specific milestones or performance measures that are tied toappropriate timelines. This section does not apply if the forfeitureis inconsistent with any federal requirements that are a prescribedcondition for the allocation of federal funds to the state or thecounty.
